shared.note: Editorial visual comparisons only. Preserve both source actions and the original v1 files.

variants.label: V2 · Right compact
variants.description: A smaller right-hand portrait leaves more of the input rows visible; longer fades and a lighter shadow.

variants.label: V3 · Left compact
variants.description: Tests the opposite side. Input rows remain clear, but the lower receiving subbelt is partly covered.

variants.label: V4 · Soft overlay
variants.description: Feathered edges, slight translucency and no drop shadow create a softer transition between real footage and simulation.

variants.label: V5 · Lower-right inset
variants.description: A smaller portrait sits near the lower-right corner, keeping most of the plant visible; exits slightly earlier.

variants.label: V6 · Floating right
variants.description: A larger portrait settles gently into position during the fade, using a quintic entry motion and slightly rounder corners.
